svg.text: Six FSR pressure sensors — breadboard wiring
Recommended analog circuit • one 10 kΩ resistor per sensor • 3.3 V only
Per channel: 3V3 → FSR → signal node → GPIO; 10 kΩ from node to GND.
Connect all 3V3 labels to ESP32 3V3 and all ground symbols to GND.
Keep the six signal nodes separate. Do not use 5 V.
